file.reasoning: Tests verify that a dependency-scanning utility correctly identifies the absence of APM and error-tracking packages as a compliance failure, and confirms that adding Sentry or OpenTelemetry resolves the observability gap.

Tests simulate the absence of telemetry instrumentation (foot-gun) versus a lightweight analytics wrapper that captures the five key lifecycle events (signup, activation, first-value-moment, retention, churn-signal) recommended by PostHog guidance.

Tests demonstrate that an unprotected auth handler allows unlimited brute-force attempts, while the safe rate-limited handler correctly blocks excessive per-IP requests within a time window and locks accounts after repeated failures.
